parts.text: The United Nations Charter established six principal organs to carry out its work: the General Assembly, Security Council, the Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), the Trusteeship Council, the International Court of Justice (ICJ), and the Secretariat. The Trusteeship Council suspended its operations in 1994 and is no longer active but legally exists.
Role: Primary deliberative and policymaking arm of the UN.

Inter-governmental organisations can seek observer status.
Permanent Observers can maintain missions at UN headquarters.

India is not one of the 9 members of the committee for the current 80th session (2025–2026)
UN 80 Initiative: Launch: March 2025 (80th Anniversary); Aim➔ Streamline operations ➔ Improve efficiency ➔ Reaffirm multilateralism.
Three Workstreams: Identify operational efficiencies ➔ Review mandate implementations ➔ Execute structural & programmatic realignments.
Coordination: Led by UN80 Task Force (Under-Secretary-General for Policy) ➔ Drives execution across 7 thematic clusters.
Role: Maintaining international peace and security and Investigates acts of aggression and other threats to peace → Authority to impose sanctions and authorise the use of force
Members: 5 (permanent) + 10 (non-permanent; elected by UNGA for a 2-year term).
5/10 non-permanent seats are replaced annually on January 1st.
9 votes are required, including concurring votes of permanent members (i.e., no veto by any P5 member) for the Council to issue a Substantive Decisions (non-procedural).
For Procedural Decisions: Require nine affirmative votes (can be any nine members)
As of Jan 2026 non permanent members → Bahrain, Colombia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Denmark, Greece, Latvia, Liberia, Pakistan, Panama, and Somalia
Role: Central forum for discussing the world's economic, social, and environmental challenges
